procedure: Release cw-cli sweeps at the tested commit: 100 five-year seeds for each of conservative, growth, acquirer and expander policies in guided and founder starts, 20 thirty-year careers for each policy, and a 20-seed no-action baseline; dissolution_census by industry and archetype; outliers and exploits investigated in evidence/balance-report.md.
limitations: Standard difficulty only. Reference policies are scripted and hold production at full capacity whatever sells, so the naive expander loses its company in most thirty-year runs; a sell-through rule is open. Rival dissolutions 3.7 percent. Balance is not a fun sign-off; R38 human playtests remain.
